chunks: Hafs narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He pays back the prayer in which he regained consciousness.

key_terms.فِيهَا: in it (referring to the specific prayer time)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on prayer for someone who faints and wakes up during a prayer time?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify that the obligation of *qada* (making up) prayer is strictly limited to the specific prayer time window in which the unconsciousness occurred, rather than a blanket requirement for all missed prayers. This distinction highlights the Shia juristic principle that the duty to pray is contingent upon the presence of the prayer's time, and once that specific time passes without the person being conscious, the obligation for that particular prayer is lifted unless otherwise specified by other evidences.
